title: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%, Smoothing Serum for Blemish-Prone Skin
features: BOOSTS BRIGHTNESS & SMOOTHNESS: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% visibly improves skin radiance and smooths texture in one week.
HYDRATING FORMULA: Lightweight water-based serum that reinforces the skin barrier and provides hydration in as little as 7 days.
CONTAINS NIACINAMIDE & ZINC PCA: High 10% concentration of Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) and 1% Zinc PCA to help control oil in 3 days.
REDUCES PORE VISIBILITY: Clinical testing shows appearance of pores is minimized in 4 weeks, improving signs of congesting.
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS: Apply a few drops to the face in the morning and evening. Patch test before use and avoid broken skin.
